name: pg-control
description: Positive and negative controls: transactions written directly against node-postgres. `correct` checks PostgreSQL's reply to COMMIT and reports a COMMIT error as a failure; `unsafe` deliberately gets these wrong. Used to show that the runner passes a known-good implementation and detects a known-bad one. `expectations` states each mode's expected classification per case; a framework's result for a case counts only when these hold in the same run.

modes.description: Positive control: reads the command tag of PostgreSQL's reply to COMMIT, reports a COMMIT error as a failure, and discards a connection whose ROLLBACK failed.

Negative control: ignores the command tag of the reply to COMMIT, reports any COMMIT error as a rollback, ignores failed savepoint rollbacks, returns a connection whose ROLLBACK failed to its pool as it is, and defers a write made before a nested scope into that scope's savepoint.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: The control has no propagation modes, so it has no API that promises an independent inner transaction, and the hazard TX-04.3 targets (pending outer writes committed by the inner transaction) cannot arise.
